title: Service Delivery Standard — Data Collection and Performance Reporting for Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Data Collection and Performance Reporting

Service delivery standard for the data and reporting obligations of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

## Standard

Interval data is collected at the tier's interval and kept available for the tier's retention period, and utility bills are captured at the tier's capture frequency for the tier's included billing accounts. A reading posted from a utility bill and a reading posted from an interval meter are kept as separate records for the same period, and where they disagree the metered reading governs the reports while the billed reading governs anything the owner is charged. The performance report is issued at the tier's frequency and delivered within the tier's report period, counted in business days after the reported period closed on the office calendar, which excludes Saturdays, Sundays and the office holidays published for the year. Where a report is delivered later than that period, the tier's late report credit of that period's subscription fee is credited to the owner. Benchmarking, energy performance submissions and emissions reporting are delivered only at the tiers that include them, and a caller asking for one at a tier that does not include it is quoted the analyst hours instead. The interval, the retention period, the report frequency, the report period and the late credit percentage are the figures fixed for the tier.

## Which reading governs

| Question | Governing record |
|---|---|
| What the report shows for the period | the metered reading |
| What the owner is charged for the period | the billed reading |

The two readings are never merged into one record; both stand for the same period.

## Report delivery period

The period is counted in business days from the close of the reported period. A business day is a day on the office calendar other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a published office holiday. A report delivered on the last business day of the period is on time; a report delivered on the next business day is late, and the late report credit — the tier's percentage of that period's subscription fee — is credited to the owner.

*Hypothetical:* a period closes on a Friday and the tier's report period is 5 business days; with no holiday in the week, the fifth business day is the following Friday, and delivery on the Monday after is late.

## Deliverables outside the tier

A request for benchmarking, an energy performance submission or emissions reporting at a tier that does not include it is answered with a quotation of analyst hours for the work, not with the deliverable.
